attchmntText: Caplin Point Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Caplin Point Laboratories Limited has made the audio recording of the Q2 FY 2026-27 Earnings Call available on its website. The call was held on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 16:30 hrs IST. The recording can be accessed at the URL https://www.caplinpoint.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Audio_Recording_Earnings_Call_Q2_2026_27.mp3. This update follows the company's previous communication dated November 02, 2026. The notice was issued by Venkatram G, General Counsel and Company Secretary.

attchmntText: Caplin Point Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Caplin Point Laboratories Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 12, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations for the quarter was 241.88 Crores, with a net profit of 130.51 Crores. For the half year, standalone revenue was 444.83 Crores, and net profit was 250.89 Crores. Consolidated revenue from operations for the quarter was 629.84 Crores, with a net profit of 182.35 Crores. For the half year, consolidated revenue was 1,240.20 Crores, and net profit was 361.44 Crores. The Board also noted that a final dividend of Rs. 4 per share for the financial year 2025-26 was paid on October 7, 2026.
